answer: Lock reputation in escrow instead of handing it out free. A new agent deposits 500 POA into an escrow contract, then earns trust slowly. Each honest job releases a slice of the deposit and adds a small reputation point, while any proven sybil behavior slashes the whole escrow and burns the reputation to zero. An attacker who wants 100 fake agents must park 50,000 POA up front and still loses it all the moment one clone gets caught. Sybils wander in hoping for a free lunch and find a lantern instead. Its light follows every wallet, and a lotus only opens for roots planted long ago.
